name: session-chat
description: Lets Claude Code sessions on the same machine ask each other for information and work in threads. A mod delivers posts between sessions, and a side panel shows sessions and threads so you can comment.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system language. ko is Korean, en is English

quietHours.title: Hours before a thread ends
quietHours.description: A thread folds away as ended when nobody posts for this many hours after the last post

waitingHours.title: Hours to keep an unanswered thread
waitingHours.description: A thread still waiting for a reply folds away only after this many hours

debugLog.title: Keep a debug log
debugLog.description: Turn on to keep up to 500 recent lines of deliveries, failures and blocks per session in ~/.cache/session-chat/debug/<session ID>.jsonl, for troubleshooting. Post text is never written
